why: Tests step for the leakgrep-patch-blob-quotes slice, today's lead tooling. New laws in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/leakgrep.patches.test.ts, in their own describe: each builds a temp repo whose second commit rewrites a pnpm patch under patches/, and reads it with leakgrep.sh --commits HEAD~1..HEAD, so git's --unified=0 hunk starts inside one of the patch's own hunks. Three laws are red on main for the planned reason: an em dash the commit adds inside the patch's hunk (as + , +- and ++ lines) still fails, whether the patch's @@ line is untouched, renumbered or removed, because main's Quotes reads the patch's hunks only from the top of git's own hunk. Fifteen fail-closed laws are green on main and must stay green: an em dash on a @@ line the commit adds, on any line outside the patch's hunks (the first line, the diff, index and +++ lines, a free line before the first @@, an unmarked backslash line inside a hunk), a key, machine path, private word or canvas link inside a hunk, and an em dash inside a hunk of a file that is not under patches/. The build makes the three red laws green by reading the new blob's own line structure.

note: Each plant ran once on a copy of leakgrep.sh in the scratchpad through TEST_LEAKGREP, so no product file was touched. The first plant turning the three red laws green shows their red is the quote decision, not a test bug. The other four leakgrep test files: 58 passed. The patches file: 3 failed, 36 passed. pnpm format, pnpm lint (with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144) and the list ratchet pass. No typecheck in this step.
